desc: Whether today’s adventures take you to the range or the field, the rugged, abrasion and water-resistant 600-denier fabric construction of Muddy's 48″ Scoped Rifle Case has you covered. Its thick, padded foam interior delivers the cushioning and protection your favorite firearms deserve on the go while an extra-large, exterior storage pocket ensures you always know right where all of your ammo, eye protection and other must-have shooting gear is stashed, regardless of the scenario. Inside, a smooth, durable ripstop lining stands up to repeated use and abuse outdoors, providing an additional barrier of protection for firearms up to 48″ in length. It even comes with an integrated carry handle for ease of transport.
